question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Fulsome**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Sincere**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Fulsome"** means excessive or insincere praise that might come across as overdone or exaggerated. (अत्यधिक या दिखावटी प्रशंसा)
 
 
• **Example:** His fulsome compliments made everyone doubt his sincerity.
 
 
• **"Sincere"** refers to being genuine, honest, and free from pretense or deceit. (ईमानदार और सच्चा)
 
 
• **Example:** Her sincere apology was appreciated by everyone.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Fulsome'** is **'Sincere'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sincere**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Overdone** (अत्यधिक किया हुआ): Something that is excessive or exaggerated beyond what is necessary.
 
 
• **Example:** The decorations at the party were overdone and too flashy.
 
 
 
• **Excessive** (अत्यधिक): More than necessary, too much.
 
 
• **Example:** His excessive demands made it hard to work with him.
 
 
 
• **Lavish** (शानदार): Rich, elaborate, or luxurious.
 
 
• **Example:** They threw a lavish party to celebrate their anniversary.
